company.name: Railbird
company.shortDescription: Railbird is an events contracts exchange platform, where your opinions matter and can help you earn a profit from your speculation
company.description: Railbird is in the process of becoming a CFTC-regulated event contract derivative exchange that lets you trade on your predictions. Event contracts that affect your community, everyday life or even a hobby. In addition to providing a platform for retail participants to make money from predictions, Railbird was created as a way for businesses to hedge risks. Events have a tangible risk on businesses, markets, and individuals but there are often limited opportunities to hedge economic outcomes, especially in cases where the risk lies in the occurrence or non-occurrence of an event . By offering novel markets, Railbird aims to provide a platform for businesses to manage outcomes in an ever changing world. This allows businesses to confidently operate and plan for the future.
